description: This file is a Perl script that scans and analyzes source code files, build configuration files (configure.ac, CMakeLists.txt), and documentation to identify and cross-reference symbols related to build disables (CURL_DISABLE_*). It helps ensure consistency between code, configuration, and documentation for build options within the curl project.

methods.name: scanconf
methods.description: Reads a file to find symbols matching 'CURL_DISABLE_*' and stores them in the %disable hash.

methods.name: scan_configure
methods.description: Reads the configure.ac file and associated m4 files to extract build disable symbols.

methods.name: scanconf_cmake
methods.description: Reads a CMakeLists.txt file to extract build disable symbols.

methods.name: scan_file
methods.description: Reads a source file to find references to 'CURL_DISABLE_*' symbols and records their source of origin.

methods.name: scan_dir
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for source files (.c, .h) to analyze.

methods.name: scan_sources
methods.description: Scans source directories: src, lib, vtls, vauth.
